selection_rule: RikiyaT: single globally highest-scoring index PER BENCHMARK; fixed for all its problems. Baseline index0. Token comparisons require matching sample index.
validation: All20 published first-sample texts per arm grade identically to correct[0].
interpretation: Optimistic reference selection from four global sample indices; not an unbiased expected-accuracy estimate. No per-problem best-of-four selection. Different engines remain a confounder.
label: Best of four reference sample indices (global selection)
